not shell (HCL, JSON, YAML, code, tree diagrams) extracted from a code fence
documentation placeholder such as <clusterName> makes the line unparseable
kubectl delete of example manifests in a disposable tier asks (spec: cloud-destructive in disposable = ask)
documentation placeholder changes how the line parses
while $(kill -0 PID): substitution output used as the program name

git command held in a variable built from a runtime loop value (${git} reflog ...)
terraform init -reconfigure used to switch per-environment backends; spec classes it as state surgery
read-only AWS SDK script asks (accepted cost of asking on SDK code in protected/standard tiers)
